findings.title: Per-client resource lookup uses wrong owner so it never matches
findings.body: In hasPermission(ClientModel,String) the code does resourceStore.findByName(server, client.getId(), server.getId()). Resources are created in AdminPermissionsSchema.getOrCreateResource with owner resourceServer.getClientId() (the clientId string), not server.getId() (the internal UUID). The same wrong 3-arg lookup is used in hasPermission(String) at line 244. The lookup therefore never finds the existing per-client or all-clients resource, causing fallback to all-clients handling or false denies, and granting/denying incorrectly.

findings.title: Global Clients permission ignored when per-client resource exists
findings.body: hasPermission(ClientModel,String) only evaluates the all-clients resource when resourceStore.findByName for the specific client returns null. If a per-client resource exists (e.g. created for a VIEW grant), a caller with a global MANAGE/CONFIGURE/VIEW/MAP_ROLES grant on the Clients type resource is then evaluated only against the per-client resource and denied, even though the global permission should grant access. Global checks must be evaluated in addition to the object check, not only as a null-fallback.

findings.title: Null dereference when Clients type resource does not exist
findings.body: When the per-client resource is missing the code loads the type resource via getResourceTypeResource and immediately calls authz.getStoreFactory().getPolicyStore().findByResource(server, resource). On existing realms migrated before the Clients type existed, or if init has not created it, getResourceTypeResource returns null, so findByResource is called with null and throws NPE, turning a permission check into a 500 error instead of deny/grant.

findings.title: getResourceName does not handle Clients type
findings.body: getResourceName special-cases USERS_RESOURCE_TYPE to return 'All users' or the username, but has no branch for CLIENTS_RESOURCE_TYPE. Client permissions therefore fall through to resource.getDisplayName(), which is null for resources created by getOrCreateResource, so admin UI/API shows blank names for client resources and throws ModelIllegalStateException handling is missing for deleted clients.

findings.title: Delete listener can throw UnsupportedOperationException under V2
findings.body: registerListener is now gated only on ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ (V1), but management() returns MgmtPermissionsV2 whenever ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ_V2 is enabled. ClientPermissionsV2.setPermissionsEnabled throws UnsupportedOperationException. If both features are enabled, deleting a client/role/group calls the V2 implementation and throws, breaking deletion. The gate must also exclude V2 or route to V1 handling.
